name: sqlfrontend-spike-main-limits
body: Program.Main accepts --cache-dir and --cache-key and ignores them, so sqlfrontend keeps no per-language artifact cache of its own, unlike csharpfrontend; and a flag given without a following value is ignored as in the C# frontend, so a trailing --targets with no file reports missing --targets. Upgrade if the sql stream ever needs cached artifacts or a valueless flag must be its own usage error.
